genotype_plink_bfilegz.description: Prefix for gzipped PLINK binary files (.fam.gz, .bim.gz, .bed.gz)

genetic_map_file.description: Oxford-format genetic map file for recombination rate interpolation

remove_file.description: File listing individuals to remove (FID IID in first two columns, no header)

exclude_file.description: File listing SNPs to exclude (SNP ID in first column, no header)

max_missing_per_snp.description: Maximum per-SNP missing rate (QC filter); default matches --maxMissingPerSnp

pheno_file.description: Phenotype file (must include header; FID IID in first two columns)

pheno_use_fam.description: Use the last (6th) column of .fam file as phenotype (overrides phenoFile/phenoCol)

covar_file.description: Covariate file (must include header; FID IID in first two columns)

covar_use_missing_indic.description: Include samples with missing covariates using missing-indicator method

run_reml.description: Run BOLT-REML for variance components analysis (heritability/correlation only)

run_lmm.description: Run BOLT-LMM (infinitesimal + Bayesian non-inf mixture model)

run_lmm_inf_only.description: Run BOLT-LMM under the infinitesimal model only

run_lmm_force_non_inf.description: Force non-infinitesimal association stats even when expected power gain is negligible

model_snps_file.description: File(s) listing SNPs to use in model (e.g., GRM); if omitted, uses all non-excluded SNPs

ld_scores_file.description: LD Scores file for Bayesian association stats calibration

stats_file.description: Output file for association statistics at PLINK genotypes

dosage_file.description: Dosage file(s) for imputed SNP association testing

dosage_fid_iid_file.description: File listing FIDs/IIDs corresponding to dosage_file(s)

stats_file_dosage_snps.description: Output file for dosage-based association statistics

impute2_file_list.description: List of [chr file] pairs for IMPUTE2 probability files

impute2_fid_iid_file.description: File listing FIDs/IIDs corresponding to impute2_file_list

impute2_min_maf.description: MAF threshold for IMPUTE2 SNPs; lower-MAF SNPs are ignored

bgen_file.description: Oxford BGEN format file(s) for genotype association testing

sample_file.description: Corresponding Oxford sample file for BGEN file(s)

bgen_sample_file_list.description: List of [bgen sample] file pairs for BGEN imputed variants

stats_file_bgen_snps.description: Output file for BGEN-based association statistics

stats_file_impute2_snps.description: Output file for IMPUTE2-based association statistics

dosage2_file_list.description: List of [map dosage] file pairs with 2-dosage format (Ricopili/plink2 --dosage format=2)

stats_file_dosage2_snps.description: Output file for 2-dosage format association statistics
